records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 52% and 49% of our consolidated revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, as compared to 46% and 44% for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our continued execution delivered strong results during the third quarter of 2025, driven primarily by increasing demand for our memory interface chips.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 primarily included decreases in unbilled receivables and prepaids and other current assets and an increase in income taxes payable, offset by increases in income taxes receivable, inventories and accounts receivable, and a decrease in accrued salaries and benefits.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue increased approximately $9.7 million and $29.9 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, as compared to the same periods in 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities of $260.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, was primarily attributable to the cash generated from product sales, customer licensing and engineering services fees.
